chunks: So fear God and listen to me.

key_terms.فَاتَّقُوا: Fear God / Be conscious of God

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet command believers to do in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a divine mandate for the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to guide his people, emphasizing that obedience to him is intrinsically linked to God-consciousness (taqwa). Shia scholarship often views this as a precursor to the concept of Wilayah, where following the Prophet's authority is a pathway to spiritual success and avoiding the path of the disbelievers.
